page.layout: One page of text, one block, with a marginal note at the upper right. Running head at the top left, page number at the top right, catchword and gathering mark at the foot.

main_text.p: Iesus det nobis, istiusmodi tentationes fide & spe inuicta superare: Amen.
main_text.head: VERSUS III.
main_text.p: Lectio 8. Cal. Septbr. 1581.Ut quid ostendis mihi molestiam, & per-versitatem aspicis: & est vastitas & vio-lentia coram me? estq; qui litem & con-tentionem (contra me) suscipiat?
Propheta rei indignitatem amplificat, enumeratione rerum non solum inhonestarum, sed etiam perniciosarum.
Cui bono non ex animo doleat, impune grassari atrocia delicta, quae turbant societatem & tranquillitatem generis humani?
Atqui hoc tempore molestia, perversi-tas, vastitas, violentia, lis, contentio, & a-liae pestes mirum in modum grassantur. Pellitur e medio sapientia, vi geritur res.
Quare in summo moerore esse bonos omnes, nihil dubiū est: ut qui, quae'nam scelerum auctoramenta secutura sint, nō obscure videant.
Cum vocabula quae in Minore occur-runt, saepe cōfundantur, nō laborabimus in ijsdem scrupulose distinguendis.

page.notes: The signature mark at the foot is read as "d" and is doubtful. The catchword "DE TRA-" is taken as printed, with its hyphen. The marginal note is set in three short lines, and I have run them together into one note. The word "quae'nam" has an apostrophe-like mark in the print, which I kept as it stands. The bottom-left mark in the running head has been checked against the print and is not counted as text.
